contentBlocks.body: A common pattern is folding a list into an object that counts or indexes its items. Walk the list and update a key on an accumulator object, starting from {}.

payload.text: counts[word] = (counts[word] ?? 0) + ____ adds one, treating a missing key as 0.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return an object mapping each word to how many times it appears in the list.
